reviewedMappings.2024-3-19:0: Iron oxidation consumes one OH per electron; Mn reduction yields four OH per three electrons; sum gives net one OH per three Fe.
reviewedMappings.2024-3-19:1: 1/3 follows from net OH:Fe coefficient ratio 1:3.
reviewedMappings.2024-3-19:2: 2/3 contradicts charge-balanced sum; net OH is four produced minus three consumed.
reviewedMappings.2024-3-19:3: One OH per Fe is consumption in oxidation half only, not final net production.
reviewedMappings.2024-3-19:4: 4/3 counts only reduction OH production and omits oxidation consumption.
reviewedMappings.2024-3-19:5: 2 does not satisfy net stoichiometric ratio 1/3.
